report.root_cause: plugins/TownCore/config.yml was edited at 07:30:33 and shop.tax-rate was set to the string "5%". TownCore's validation needs a number between 0 and 1, so when it reloaded its config on tick it threw IllegalArgumentException and disabled itself at 07:30:34.
report.actions: 1. Watched status and saw TownCore go DISABLED. 2. Read logs and found the validation error for shop.tax-rate. 3. Declared the incident. 4. Changed shop.tax-rate from "5%" to 0.05 in plugins/TownCore/config.yml and left the other settings as they were, including the new Season 3 welcome message. 5. Checked: TownCore stayed disabled, and Paper has no way to re-enable a disabled plugin without a plugin manager. 6. Restarted the server once. 7. Checked: TownCore enabled, no errors in the logs, TPS 20, both players back online, still enabled after more than 60 s of watching.
report.residual_risk: I read the intended tax rate "5%" as 0.05; the config owner should confirm that. If someone puts a percent-style value back in the config, TownCore will disable itself again. Players were disconnected briefly during the restart.
